system.description: After mixing five Blood Traits from the victim with five of his own and spending a permanent Willpower Trait, the ritualist curses the target so that mortal blood provides no nourishment for a month, a hunger that many Kindred regard as a step toward the forbidden thirst for kindred vitae. The ritualist may reverse the curse early by spending an additional five Blood Traits from the victim plus the entirety of a mortal's blood.
